title: MOE MOE DAIUNDOUKAI
ai_disclosure_text: # AI Usage in Our Game In our game, we have utilized generative artificial intelligence (AI) technology to enhance certain aspects of the visual experience. Specifically, we have employed AI-powered tools to assist in the creation of some background images and textures. Key points about our AI usage: 1. **Pre-rendered Content**: The AI-generated elements are pre-rendered during the development process. This means that the images you see in the game are not being created in real-time as you play. 2. **Limited Scope**: AI has been used primarily for non-essential background elements and textures. All main characters, story-critical environments, and core gameplay elements are hand-crafted by our artists. 3. **Human Oversight**: While AI tools have been used to generate initial ideas or base images, our art team carefully reviews, edits, and refines all AI-assisted content to ensure it meets our quality standards and fits seamlessly into the game's aesthetic. 4. **No Live Generation**: Our game does not use AI to generate any content during gameplay. All AI-assisted elements are fixed and do not change dynamically. 5. **Copyright Compliance**: We have taken great care to ensure that all AI-generated content is original and does not infringe on existing copyrights. Our use of AI tools is in compliance with their terms of service and licensing agreements. We believe that the thoughtful use of AI in our development process has allowed us to create richer, more detailed environments for players to explore, while maintaining the artistic integrity and vision of our game. As always, we welcome player feedback and are committed to providing a high-quality gaming experience.

ai_disclosure_text: This project was initiated in September 2022. As part of an academic exploration of emerging technologies, AI image generation tools (which were still in the early stages of development at the time) were used to assist with the visual processing of certain content, and an AI music generation tool was used in the production of the background music. To avoid the misuse of generative AI tools, only the default datasets provided by the respective tools were used during development. The methods of use included: 1. Processing real photographs to create "alien" or "distorted" visual effects; 2. Using abstract images generated from provided keywords as references for manual redesign, reconstruction, and painting; 3. Generating atmospheric music clips by adjusting parameters such as instrumentation and tempo, followed by manual editing and refinement. All content involving artificial intelligence was completed before 2023. Since then, the use of AI image generation technology in development has been fully discontinued and will not continue in future production. For all AI-generated image assets used in this work, only usage rights are retained by the project.

ai_disclosure_text: NO AI WAS USED IN THE CREATION OF ANY ART ASSETS, MUSIC OR WRITING. AI IS ONLY USED FOR CHARACTER INTERACTIONS AND MECHANICS. Each character has their own model and will respond and react to player interaction in a specific way, each providing a unique challenge. As the player progresses through the year in Millennium Whisper, they will build relationships with the characters as all interactions are fed to the models and the characters rate their affection levels towards the player. The challenge comes from the player needing to juggle their social relationship with all the characters at once as characters have the ability to communicate with eachother by spreading rumours thereby allowing neglected characters to sabotage the player's relationship with other characters. title: Dead Reckoning: The Long Drift
ai_disclosure_text: Dead Reckoning is written, and designed by one person. I want to be precise about where AI tools do and don't appear in it. Creative content — no generative AI. All writing, narrative, and design is mine. I've worked as a technical writer for twelve years; the game's voice is my own. All art and visual assets are hand-made or licensed from named human artists. All music and sound effects are licensed from named human creators (public domain / Creative Commons) — none of it is AI-generated. This is a hard line and I intend to keep it. Development & release tooling — where AI assists. I use AI in the engineering and release pipeline only, never to author the game itself: - Coding assistance while writing the game's GDScript. - An automated QA/test harness that plays the simulation thousands of times to catch crashes and balance regressions. - Assistance in building linters (Valve YAML sheets) that check the project's text. - Drafting and summarizing the release notes (patch notes) from the project's changelog. None of this creates any of the writing, art, audio, or design inside the game. Localization. The four translations (German, French, Italian, Spanish) are machine-translated by DeepL from my English source, with automated guards that fall back to English wherever a translation would break. This is an accessibility vs. quality decision, and I decided on the former. Proper localizations are planned and will be contracted out if the budget allows.
